svg.title: Plugin lifecycle in CorvinOS
svg.desc: Swimlane: operator discovers a plugin in the console or CLI, installs it through the manifest gate into the tenant registry, enables it, the runtime loads it, and every step is recorded in the audit chain. Update and remote or community install are not built.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Discover, install, enable, load, audit — every step on a real route. Update and remote install are not built yet.
